acceptanceCriteria: A test or recorded experiment shows what a pre-#1085 reader does with a progress-carrying record.
Either the rollback is safe, or the spec rollback paragraph names the exact recovery and it is tested.
body: Residual from V1-1608 (PR #1085, ATR spec Rollback paragraph for ATR-V0-080..084). Inference, untested: a build before #1085 decoding a claim loopEvidence record that carries progress{signal,fingerprint} refuses it as MALFORMED, so rolling back the binary after any progress-signalled claim could leave the store unreadable. Expected: a tested rollback path (older reader tolerates or a documented migration).
title: rollback: an earlier build may refuse attempt records carrying `progress` as MALFORMED
